name: How much does it cost to hire a San Diego dog bite lawyer?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a San Diego dog bite lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most San Diego dog bite lawyers, including the Law Office of Brett Peterson, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the compensation you receive if your case is successful. If you don't win, you generally don't owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden. Initial consultations are typically free, providing an opportunity to discuss your case without obligation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many San Diego dog bite lawyers work on a contingency fee, meaning you pay no upfront fees and only pay if they win your case. Initial consultations are usually free.
